insights.programMetrics.acceptance.empty: No assignments with an SLA in this period
insights.programMetrics.acceptance.info: Findings assigned in this period to a named owner. Accepted when that owner changed status, triaged, commented, updated remediation or resolved it before the finding’s SLA deadline. Missed when the deadline passed without that. Assignments still inside their SLA window, without an SLA, or handed to someone else first are left out of the rate.
insights.programMetrics.acceptance.title: Owner acceptance rate
insights.programMetrics.controls.caption: {lacking} lacking, {unknown} not recorded, of {total}
insights.programMetrics.controls.edr.inf: Hosts rated critical or marked as crown jewels whose "EDR installed" attribute is false or not recorded. Not recorded counts as a gap: no source has reported EDR on the host.
insights.programMetrics.controls.empty: No critical assets of this kind
insights.programMetrics.controls.heading: Critical assets lacking a control
insights.programMetrics.controls.logging: Storage assets rated critical or marked as crown jewels whose "Logging" attribute is false or not recorded. Not recorded counts as a gap.
insights.programMetrics.controls.mfa.inf: Cloud accounts and identities rated critical or marked as crown jewels whose "MFA" attribute is false or not recorded. Not recorded counts as a gap.
insights.programMetrics.cycles.caption: {onTime} of {due} on time, {late} late, {open} open
insights.programMetrics.cycles.empty: No cycle was due in this period
insights.programMetrics.cycles.info: CTEM cycles whose end date fell in this period. On time when the cycle was closed by the end of its end date. "Criteria met" is the average share of measurable charter success criteria met at close.
insights.programMetrics.cycles.title: Cycles completed on time
insights.programMetrics.description: How fast the program detects, validates, fixes and takes ownership. “—” means there is not enough data to measure it yet.
insights.programMetrics.mttd.empty: No new internet-facing assets in this period
insights.programMetrics.mttd.info: Assets first seen in this period that are internet-facing now. Measured from when the asset was first seen to the earliest sign it was known to be internet-facing: its exposure being set to public, an internet-exposure change in its history, its first exposure event, or its first finding. Known at discovery counts as 0 h. Assets with no such sign are not averaged.
insights.programMetrics.mttd.title: Time to detect internet-facing assets
insights.programMetrics.mttr.empty: No validated exposures resolved in this period
insights.programMetrics.mttr.info: Findings a validation run reproduced (outcome "detected", still exploitable) and that were then resolved or verified in this period. Measured from the first reproducing validation to resolution. False positives, accepted risk and fixes made before validation are excluded.
insights.programMetrics.mttr.title: Time to remediate validated exposures
insights.programMetrics.mttv.empty: No P0 or P1 findings detected in this period
insights.programMetrics.mttv.info: P0 and P1 findings first detected in this period. Measured from detection to the first conclusive validation: reproduced or not reproduced. Inconclusive or failed runs do not count. False positives and duplicates are left out.
insights.programMetrics.mttv.title: Time to validate priority exposures
insights.programMetrics.timeToBreak.capt: Not measured: attack-path history isn’t stored
insights.programMetrics.timeToBreak.info: Not computed. Attack paths are calculated on demand from the current asset graph and never stored, and exposure and relationship changes keep no history — so there is no record of when a path opened or when one of its links was fixed. Any number here would be invented.
insights.programMetrics.timeToOwner.empt: No new internet-facing assets in this period
insights.programMetrics.timeToOwner.info: The same new internet-facing assets. Measured from when the asset was first seen to when its first owner (a person or a group) was assigned. An owner set before discovery counts as 0 h. Assets still without an owner are not averaged and are listed below the value.
insights.programMetrics.title: CTEM program metrics
insights.scoringChange.note: Scoring changed on {date} ({what}): values before and after are not directly comparable.
